name: The Brokild Collection (all ten)
description: Every Brokild plugin in one download: eight instruments and two effects for Windows, with their manuals and their standalones. They were built one at a time, each to answer a different question, but they share a rack of global effects that runs inside the instruments, one patch folder, and a way of working — nothing asserted, everything measured by a bench that renders real audio and reads the numbers off it. Each plugin in here is byte-for-byte the same file as its own download.
note: Windows VST3 · 93 MB · eight instruments and two effects · all manuals included.
